sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) All revenues raised or received in various ways for the purposes of the Government of the United Republic, except revenues of the kind referred to in subarticle (2), shall be paid into one special fund to be known as the Consolidated Fund of the Government. (2) Revenues which shall not be paid into the Consolidated Fund are those which a law provides shall be applied for a specific purpose or paid into another fund for a specific purpose.
vifungu: (1) All revenues raised or received in various ways for the purposes of the Government of the United Republic, except revenues of the kind referred to in subarticle (2), shall be paid into one special fund to be known as the Consolidated Fund of the Government.
